## 1. GTA 6 Heist Vaults & Max Projected Payouts

1. **Leonida State Gold Reserve Infiltration** — https://www.gta6heistguide.com/leonida-reserve.html
   - Max Payout: $25,000,000 base ($37,500,000 during 1.5X Weekly Featured Rotation)
   - Best Approach: Silent Sewer Intake + Thermal Lance (+5% Stealth Integrity Bonus)
   - Recommended Crew Cut: 10% Ghost Hacker / 15% Gunner / 8% Getaway Wheelman (67% Player Squad Take)

2. **Sinfrontera National Bank Vault Raid** — https://www.gta6heistguide.com/sinfrontera-bank.html
   - Max Payout: $14,500,000
   - Best Approach: Ocean Blvd Subterranean Drainage Grates + Electrical Transformer EMP
   - Vault Tip: Keep laser drill core below 800C while cycling biometric dual-key locks.

3. **Starlet Superyacht Offshore Heist** — https://www.gta6heistguide.com/vice-city-yacht-heist.html
   - Max Payout: $11,800,000
   - Best Approach: Sub-Aquatic Scuba Hull Breach + Rebreather Coral Ditch (avoids 4-star Coast Guard radar trigger).

4. **Ocean Drive Armored Depository Ambush** — https://www.gta6heistguide.com/ocean-drive-armored-convoy.html
   - Max Payout: $9,400,000
   - Best Approach: Dual Magnetic EMP Intercept + Vice Transit Subway Tunnel Evasion.

5. **Port Gellhorn Container Terminal Heist** — https://www.gta6heistguide.com/port-gellhorn.html
   - Max Payout: $8,200,000
   - Best Approach: Night Crane Terminal RFID Manifest Scan + Canal Interceptor Speedboat Escape.

6. **Grassrivers Cartel Airstrip Raid** — https://www.gta6heistguide.com/everglades-smuggler-run.html
   - Max Payout: $6,500,000
   - Best Approach: Thermal Night-Vision Airboat Ingress + Low-Altitude Bush Plane Skim (< 120 ft).

- **Bookmarkable Heist Cut Planner & Vault Keypad Trainer** — https://www.gta6heistguide.com/heist-planner.html
  Simulates 1 to 4 player squad payouts, stealth vs. aggressive approach modifiers, specialist deductions, shareable squad URL parameters, and includes an interactive 5-digit biometric keypad reaction trainer.
- **Interactive Leonida Satellite Radar Map** — https://www.gta6heistguide.com/interactive-map.html
  Interactive SVG radar mapping heist vaults, sewer conduits, and confirmed Leonida map regions.
- **Co-Op LFG Friend Finder & Syndicate Forum** — https://www.gta6heistguide.com/forum.html
  Cloudflare D1 backed player matchmaker filtering squads by PS5 Pro, Xbox Series X|S, and PC across Mastermind, Ghost Hacker, Wheelman, and Enforcer roles.
- **Live GTA 6 News, Weekly Meta Rotation & DMCA Rules** — https://www.gta6heistguide.com/live-intel.html
  Automatically rolls over the Thursday 10:00 UTC featured heist target, syncs real-time GTA 6 news breakdowns, and enforces 100% DMCA strike-free editorial rules.

## 3. Confirmed Rockstar GTA 6 Characters, Crew & Leonida Regions

- **Lucia Caminos & Jason Duval (Synergy Guide)** — https://www.gta6heistguide.com/lucia-jason-skills.html
  Lucia Caminos specializes in electronics keypad bypasses (-22% decrypt time), crowd control, and ventilation infiltration. Jason Duval specializes in sniper overwatch, high-speed rain getaway recovery, and suppression cover.
- **Confirmed Leonida Network Contacts (Crew Roster)** — https://www.gta6heistguide.com/crew-database.html
  Features veteran bank heist operator Raul Bautista, Vice City entrepreneur Boobie Ike, Only Raw Records founder Dre'Quan Priest, Real Dimez, Keys smuggler Brian Heder, and police-scanner tech Cal Hampton, plus hired specialist tiers (6%-15% cuts).
- **Leonida Map Regions Covered**:
  Vice City, Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia, and Mount Kalaga National Park.

  Compares front business cleaning (Vice Beach Nightclub 8% fee / +5% multiplier) against Offshore Marina brokers (12%) and instant bullion fences (22%).
- **Wanted System, CCTV Forensics & Evasion Calculator** — https://www.gta6heistguide.com/leonida-wanted-system.html
  Models 1-6 star heat cooldowns, vehicle/plate swapping (-38% radar duration), clothing swaps (-28%), and weather masking (-15%).
- **Gameplay Meta Breakdown** — https://www.gta6heistguide.com/gameplay-mechanics.html
  Covers realistic duffel bag weight penalties (-25% gold sprint penalty vs. 0% uncut diamonds), trunk weapon stashes, and camera tracking.
